data.title: Golfville
data.about:
Cherish modern living in the green heart of Dubai to the fullest and bask in the unending views of the lush park and golf course. Golfville at Dubai Hills Estate by Emaar opens up a world of extraordinary experiences for the whole family as connection, community, and well-being perfectly harmonises with fine living.

Choose a lifestyle worth living. Make Golfville your home in the city today!

Interactive Living Like No Other

Give your family the best of what life has to offer by experiencing interactive living at its finest. For the very first time in the history of Dubai, Emaar proudly launches this revolutionary way of living that enables you and your neighbours to establish meaningful connections, grow together, and share wonderful inspirations in a modern, stylish setting.

Your Secret Haven in the City

With a choice of 1 and 2-bedroom apartments against the backdrop of breathtaking park and golf views, great moments await you in this premier residential destination. Add to that an array of premium amenities, ease of accessibility, and collaborative lifestyle, this is a haven you never want to leave.

location_tile.title: This is where your family will create wonderful memories and thrive for a bright future.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Located at the iconic green heart of Dubai, Golfville at Dubai Hills Estate by Emaar gives a twist to modern lifestyle by introducing the first-ever concept of collaborative living. 

  • Footsteps away from the 18-hole championship golf course
  • A stone’s throw from the new clubhouse
  • 5 minutes away from Dubai Hills Park
  • 5 minutes away from Dubai Hills Mall
  • 20 – 25 minutes to Dubai International Airport
  • 20 – 25 minutes to Al Maktoum Airport
